So... All of this is complicated and I cannot provide valuable input.   The basic rules are.. we need to have this mapped as a unit of work that is not lost. Every pr and wait ends up being a point where a session gets forgotten and the work abandoned 

Is the goal recorded?
Do we have a unit of work that can be completed?
Do we know how to recognise when we have made a mistake?
Do we understand why we need to take each action and are we sure we are not going in circles?

Our job is not a perfect system , but a way to know that we are improving and an awareness of the tradeoffs so that we are tuning
